src: U.S. Census Bureau, cartographic boundary file cb_2022_us_cd118_500k
cd.vint: The Census Bureau's lines of the 118th Congress's districts (its file says session 118).
rec: Special master's (Jonathan Cervas) congressional plan certified by the Supreme Court, Steuben County on May 20, 2022 after the Court of Appeals voided the Legislature's Feb. 2022 map (Chapter 13 of 2022); 26 districts
N.Y. Supreme Court, Steuben County, Harkenrider v Hochul, Decision and Order of May 20, 2022 (certifies the 2022 Congressional and State Senate maps)

Used in the Nov. 8, 2022 election only (the Court of Appeals expected the congressional and Senate primaries to move to August). The Legislature's own Chapter 13 map was never used. Census cb_2022 cd118 file: 26 districts; all 26 district areas differ from the 2020 file (27 districts) and 17 of 26 differ by more than 0.5 percent from the 2024 file, which holds the 2024 plan. I could not read the special master's district descriptions, so I did not compare the file with the plan's text; Census says the file reflects what the states supplied by Aug. 31, 2022, three months after the court certified this plan, and the Legislature's voided Chapter 13 map was never used in an election.

src: U.S. Census Bureau, cartographic boundary file cb_2022_us_sldu_500k
sldu.vint: The Census Bureau's 2022 file of legislative districts, the lines it records for the 2022 legislative session year.
rec: Special master's State Senate plan certified by the Supreme Court, Steuben County on May 20, 2022 (the Senate part of the Legislature's Chapter 14 of 2022 was voided by the Court of Appeals); 63 districts
N.Y. Supreme Court, Steuben County, Harkenrider v Hochul, Decision and Order of May 20, 2022 (certifies the 2022 Congressional and State Senate maps)

Checked against the Legislature's voided plan: none of the 8 Chapter 14 Senate districts made only of whole counties and towns matches (to 0.2 percent of land area) any district in the cb_2022 or cb_2024 sldu file, so the files do not hold that plan; they are identical to each other (max difference 0.0 percent) and differ from the 2020 file in all 63 districts. Census cb_2022 sldu: LSY 2022, 63 districts.

src: U.S. Census Bureau, cartographic boundary file cb_2022_us_sldl_500k
sldl.vint: The Census Bureau's 2022 file of legislative districts, the lines it records for the 2022 legislative session year.
rec: Chapter 14 of the Laws of 2022 (S.8185-A / A.9040-A, signed Feb. 3, 2022), amended by Chapter 16 of 2022 (A.9168 / S.8197); 150 Assembly districts
N.Y. Assembly bill page S.8185-A / A.9040-A: signed chap. 14

The Court of Appeals voided the Congressional and Senate maps but not the Assembly map (footnote 15 of Harkenrider: not challenged in the pleadings), so these lines were used in 2022. Verified against the files: for the 6 Assembly districts made only of whole towns that differ between this plan and the 2023 plan, the cb_2022 file follows this plan (e.g. District 133: 3,225.6 sq km in the plan and in the file, exactly) and the cb_2024 file follows the 2023 plan. Census cb_2022 sldl: LSY 2022, 150 districts; 134 of 150 areas differ from the 2020 file by more than 0.5 percent.
